desktop.setup.runtime_ready: Local runtime: ready for the selected model
desktop.setup.runtime_pending: Local runtime: not ready for the selected model
desktop.setup.mic_available: Microphone: listed, not yet verified by recording
desktop.setup.mic_verified: Microphone: verified by the local test
desktop.setup.mic_missing: Microphone: unavailable. You can still open the app.
desktop.setup.devices_failed: Microphones could not be listed. Retry to check access.
desktop.setup.device_failed: Microphone selection failed. Retry before testing.
desktop.setup.readiness_failed: Runtime readiness could not be checked. Retry.
desktop.setup.probe_speaking: Speak a short sentence now for 5 seconds, then wait for local transcription.
desktop.setup.probe_privacy: Optional: only this test button activates the microphone. Audio goes only to built-in Whisper on this device; nothing is saved to history or pasted. This tests Dictation, not Assist or Voice Agent.
desktop.setup.probe_untested: Dictation test: not verified for this configuration
desktop.setup.probe_success: Dictation test: local speech recognized successfully
desktop.setup.probe_busy: Another desktop operation is active. Finish or cancel it, then retry.
desktop.setup.probe_unready: The selected built-in local model is not running. Finish the download and select the model, then retry.
desktop.setup.probe_cancelled: Test cancelled. No result was kept.
desktop.setup.probe_timeout: Local transcription timed out. Retry when the runtime is ready.
desktop.setup.probe_capture_failed: Microphone capture or cleanup failed. Check access and retry.
desktop.setup.probe_empty: No speech was recognized. Try another short sentence.
desktop.setup.probe_failed: Local transcription failed. Check the runtime and retry.
desktop.setup.probe_method: Start this test with the record button.
desktop.setup.save_failed: Settings were not saved successfully. Retry to finish setup.
desktop.setup.finish_hint: Opening the app does not mean models are ready or the microphone is tested. Downloads can continue; each mode needs its own requirements.
desktop.setup.download_finished: Model downloaded. Review readiness and retry saving when you choose.
desktop.route.distinct: Primary and fallback must be different. Change the other selection explicitly first.
desktop.route.server_fallback: Device fallback is enabled: if the server fails, the device may use the providers below, including cloud providers allowed by network scope.
desktop.route.title: Configured execution route
desktop.route.device_hint: This device selects the providers below, which may use cloud services. This is not an offline guarantee; fallback can vary per request.
desktop.route.server_hint: SpeechKit Server selects inference providers. The device's model choices below do not control the server route.
desktop.route.server_configured: Server connection configured; live availability is not confirmed here.
desktop.route.unavailable: Readiness could not be retrieved. Refresh to try again.
desktop.capture.busy: The current recording continues. Finish or cancel it before switching modes.
companion.home_assistant.not_configured: Home Assistant is not configured for smart-home commands.
companion.home_assistant.command.not_mat: Home Assistant could not match that smart-home command to a target.
companion.home_assistant.command.rejecte: Home Assistant rejected that smart-home command.
companion.home_assistant.unavailable: Home Assistant is currently unavailable. The smart-home command was not forwarded.
sk.privacy.disabled.cloud_provider: Cloud providers are blocked by the current privacy scope.
sk.privacy.disabled.local_service_in_dev: Network services are blocked while the privacy scope is set to this device only.
sk.privacy.disabled.server_in_device_onl: SpeechKit Server connections are blocked while the privacy scope is set to this device only.
sk.privacy.disabled.server_url_not_local: The SpeechKit Server address is not a private local-network address.
sk.privacy.disabled.agent_bridge: Agent integrations are blocked by the current privacy scope.
sk.privacy.disabled.home_assistant: Home Assistant is blocked by the current privacy scope.
sk.privacy.disabled.edge_beta: Edge features are blocked by the current privacy scope.
sk.privacy.disabled.setup_traffic: Downloads and updates are paused by the current privacy scope.
sk.privacy.disabled.telemetry: Telemetry export is disabled by the current privacy scope.
sk.privacy.disabled.cloud_account: Cloud sign-in is blocked by the current privacy scope.
sk.privacy.disabled.voice_agent_cloud: Cloud voice agents are blocked by the current privacy scope.
meeting.snapshot.error: The screenshot could not be captured.
meeting.snapshot.protected: This window is protected from screen capture. Pick another window.
meeting.snapshot.denied: This window belongs to an application that is not allowed to be captured. Pick another window.
sk.privacy.disabled.retention_ephemeral: This is not kept: the retention setting discards recordings when the meeting ends.
sk.privacy.disabled.provider_retains: This provider cannot be told to discard the request, so it is blocked by the current retention setting.
sk.policy.disabled.provider: Your organization's policy does not allow this provider.
sk.policy.disabled.no_machine_policy: No administrator policy is installed, so only on-device providers are available.
sk.meeting.preflight.ready: Microsoft Teams provides the transcript after the meeting. Someone in the meeting has to start transcription.
sk.meeting.preflight.no_teams_meeting: No scheduled Teams meeting matches this call. SpeechKit captures locally only.
sk.meeting.preflight.signed_out: Sign in to Microsoft 365 to fetch the Teams transcript after the meeting.
sk.meeting.preflight.admin_consent_requi: Your Microsoft 365 administrator has to approve SpeechKit's access to Teams transcripts. Recording is not affected.
sk.meeting.preflight.tenant_disabled: Your organization has turned off transcript access for apps in Teams. SpeechKit captures locally only.
sk.meeting.preflight.disabled: The Teams transcript import is turned off.
sk.meeting.preflight.unavailable: Microsoft 365 could not be reached just now. Recording is not affected.
sk.meeting.paste.refused.grant_missing: Allow SpeechKit to copy Microsoft 365 meeting content onto this device before pasting a transcript.
sk.meeting.paste.refused.import_off: Turn on the Teams transcript import before pasting a transcript.
sk.meeting.paste.refused.paste_off: Pasting a transcript is turned off.
sk.meeting.paste.refused.not_finished: A transcript can only be pasted into a finished meeting.
sk.meeting.paste.refused.transcript_pres: This meeting already has a transcript. Replace it explicitly to paste another one.
sk.meeting.paste.refused.too_large: The transcript is larger than 16 MB.
sk.meeting.paste.refused.unreadable: The text is not a Teams transcript (WebVTT or the Teams text format).
desktop.meeting.summary_preflight_signed: The summary provider is signed out. Recording and transcript are unaffected, but no summary is written until you sign in.
desktop.meeting.summary_preflight_no_gra: The summary provider has no permission for the transcript yet. Grant it in Settings, or this meeting stays without a summary.
desktop.meeting.summary_preflight_no_mod: No model is set up for meeting summaries. Choose one in Settings — recording and transcript keep running.
desktop.meeting.summary_preflight_degrad: The cloud model for summaries cannot be reached; the local model takes over. Summaries stay shorter and less precise.
desktop.meeting.summary_error_authentica: The summary is waiting for a sign-in: the provider refused the request. It runs again on its own once you are signed in.
desktop.meeting.summary_error_consent: The summary is waiting for permission to send the transcript to the provider.
desktop.meeting.summary_error_quota: The provider's quota is used up. The summary retries on its own.
desktop.meeting.summary_error_configurat: No model was set up when this meeting was summarized. Choose one and it runs again.
desktop.meeting.summary_error_retrying: The summary came back unusable and is being retried automatically.
desktop.meeting.summary_error_permanent: The summary failed for good. The transcript is complete and can be summarized again.
sk.export.signed_out: Sign in to Microsoft 365 to sync the meeting notes.
sk.export.consent_required: Allow SpeechKit to write your notes, then retry the sync.
sk.export.destination_gone: The destination no longer exists. Choose another one for this notebook.
sk.export.destination_full: The destination is full. Choose another one or allow a new section.
sk.export.destination_not_allowed: Your administrator does not allow writing to this destination.
sk.export.too_large: The meeting notes are too large for the destination.
sk.export.throttled: The destination is busy. SpeechKit tries again shortly.
sk.export.unavailable: The destination could not be reached. Retry later.
sk.export.failed: The meeting notes could not be synced.
sk.export.target_unavailable: This export is turned off or not available.
sk.export.no_destination: Link the meeting to a notebook with a destination first.
sk.export.review_not_ready: The meeting has no finished write-up to export yet.
sk.export.kept_until_synced: Until the sync succeeds, this meeting's transcript and screenshots stay on this device, at most until the retention limit.
